title: Events
lead: What the campus societies are putting on. Say if you're going, and meet your bonds there if you both share it.
empty: Nothing planned yet. Societies post their parties, tournaments and outings here.
emptyMine: You haven't answered any upcoming event.
going: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody's going yet} one {# person going} other {# people going}}

detail.shareHint: Your bonds who share it too will see you're going, and you'll see theirs. Nobody else.
detail.matchesEmpty: None of your bonds has shared that they're going yet.
detail.matchesHidden: Answer and turn on "Tell my bonds" to see which of them are going.
detail.cancelLead: Everyone who answered will get a notification. This can't be undone.
detail.error: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

form.lead: It shows up right away in the Campus tab of the people it's for.
form.title: Title
form.schoolsHint: With no school ticked, the event is open to the whole campus.
form.notAllowed: Only campus societies (organiser role) can publish an event.

errors.in_the_past: The start date has already passed.
errors.too_far: Events can be announced up to a year ahead.
errors.ends_before_start: The end must come after the start.
errors.too_long: An event lasts 24 hours at most.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

flash.title: Flash
flash.lead: Show your code to someone you've just met, and scan theirs. If you both scan each other, it's a bond.
flash.renewed: It changes every 30 seconds: a screenshot is useless.
flash.cameraHint: Or scan their QR code with your phone's camera.
flash.waiting: Noted. As soon as the other person scans your code, it's a bond.
flash.closed: Flash works during the event, for the people who answered it.

errors.invalid_code: This code doesn't exist or has expired. Ask for the new one.
errors.flash_closed: Flash isn't open for this event.
errors.rate_limited: Easy: wait a minute before trying again.
errors.expired: This code has expired. Ask the other person to show you the new one.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
